title: Lake Tahoe Water Sports Adventure
includes: Everything is included. Wet suits, gear, and fuel.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the thrill of water sports on Lake Tahoe with us where fun meets professionalism. Whether you’re wake surfing behind a boat, mastering wakeboarding tricks, or gliding effortlessly on water skis, the expert instructors cater to all skill levels. Enjoy tubing with the whole family, no experience necessary, or relax on a scenic boat tour through Emerald Bay. With over 20 years of experience, we ensure a safe and memorable day on the pristine waters of Lake Tahoe. We Specialize in children and family lessons and charters. Let us show you how easy it is with proper instruction. 
"We provide the fun you keep the memories"
